title: APA DATA HANDLING MODULE - EXPRO PLUS (RE-ISSUE)
description: To develop a Data Handling Module for the Advanced Power Architecture PCDU.DescriptionThe Advanced Power Architecture(APA) is a "standard concept" for the Power Conditioning and Distribution Unit (PCDU). APA follows the interoperable and interchangeable modularity approach applied for the project ADHA (Advanced Data Handling Architecture) that started in 2020. APA will be fully compatible with ADHA so that together they will form the kern of a satellite Platform. As ADHA, APA is composed of two elements: a standardizedUnit rack (element 1) that provides standard services to a set of Power Modules (element 2) that populates the rack to make an "APAPCDU". The power unit can be built upon modules from different manufacturers, based on performances, cost, programmatic constraints. This approach allows strong reduction of development time and recurrent costs, fast development and adoption of more performing technologies to name a few in great part enabled by the envisaged interoperable and interchangeable modules that compose the system. The definition the Advanced Power Architecture and related Standardization and of the development of the APA element 1 (rack product)is being addressed in a dedicated activity funded by the Preparation Element of the DPTD and by the Future EO Program (ESA/IPC(2022)1,add.42). The modules that compose the element 2 of the APA are subject to several TDE activities. Element 1 outputs (APA Unit requirements and standard requirements for APA Modules) will be used as inputs to Element 2 activities. Element 2 outputs (APA Modules)will then be used as input to Element 1 (for the validation of standard power modules requirements and overall APA architecture).This activity is devoted to the development of a Data Handling (DH) module for an APA PCDU. The DH module shall be fully compatible with ADHA.The DH module includes:- External interfaces with the digital communication bus selected in ADHA- Internal telemetry andtelecommand processing- Functionally to operate in oscilloscope mode with the telemetry lines of the unit- Implement health monitoring algorithms for the different APA modulesThis activity encompasses the following tasks:- Consolidation of APA Requirements (generic and specific modules)- Evaluation of the most promising technologies/components- Preliminary and detailed design definition- Manufacturing and testing the module- Issue Design documentation, Module Technical Specification and User Manual- Contribution to the APA Unit integration and test, including documentation and interoperability/interchangeability test
